text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT rwinf-504 resolved — mitigation applied. Customer impact: AcmeCorp ~27% error rate, 2026-03-16T14:02:00Z → 2026-03-16T14:18:00Z. Runbook fallback to model-variant-b. Pager: @eng-oncall handled. Shall we schedule a PIR?

zoe: Can we schedule a PIR? Need facilitator + 30m slot. Prefer within next 72h.

lee: I can facilitate but heads-up: travel Wed afternoon (UTC-7). available Mon/Tue 15-18UTC.

omar: Thanks — I took notes during mitigation. happy to co-run and own action list.

sasha: Can we get CS (irene) in check? customer wants readout. Also please add runtime and infra leads.

irene: I'll join for the customer readout. prefer Tue or Thu morning PST.

zoe: Proposed slots: Mon 16:00 UTC (09:00 PDT), Tue 17:00 UTC (10:00 PDT). who can make either?

lee: Prefer Mon slot. marking on my calendar tentatively.

omar: Tue works better for me (timezone). If lee still wants to facilitate, can co-facilitate Tue.

sasha: If lee is travel Wed, co-facilitation Tue seems safer. Volunteer backup: sasha.

zoe: OK booking Tue 17:00 UTC for 30m. @lee confirmed as primary facilitator, @sasha backup. @omar to capture mitigation notes and actions. @irene to represent CS. I'll send calendar invite.

devops-bot: PIR doc created: https://docs.internal/rwinf/504-pir (permissions: eng+cs).

omar: Added initial timeline and logs in doc. I'll add per-action owners today.

lee: Quick ask — can someone paste the key error logs into the doc? I only have aggregated metrics.

sasha: pasted the error snippet and root-cause hypothesis. TLDR: KV cache eviction + model-variant fallback race.

irene: I'll prepare the customer impact slide (two bullets) and send to doc.

zoe: Actions: 1) Add long-term fix plan (owner: infra-team) 2) Short-term rollback protection (owner: runtime) 3) Customer readout prep (owner: irene) 4) Post-deploy monitor (owner: omar). Can owners confirm by EOD?

omar: confirming post-deploy monitor owner.

lee: confirming I will run the retro facilitation and pre-read.

sasha: confirming backup facilitation + I own short-term rollback task.

irene: confirming CS readout. will add slides by EOD.

zoe: :thumbsup: I'll send calendar invite w/ Zoom + agenda. Please add any major items to doc before invite.
